# `adt roundtrip`

Deploy files to SAP, import back, and compare (roundtrip test)

```bash
adt roundtrip [options] [files...]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description                                                                                               | Default |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `[files...]` | Specific files or glob patterns to test (e.g., zage_fixed_values.doma.xml, *.doma.xml). Omit to test all. |         |

**Options**

| Option                              | Description                                                | Default   |
| ----------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `-s, --source <path>`               | Source directory containing serialized files               | `.`       |
| `-f, --format <format>`             | Format plugin: abapgit \| @abapify/adt-plugin-abapgit      | `abapgit` |
| `-p, --package <package>`           | Target package for new objects                             |           |
| `-t, --transport <request>`         | Transport request for changes                              |           |
| `--types <types>`                   | Filter by object types (comma-separated)                   |           |
| `--activate`                        | Activate objects after deploy (use --no-activate to skip)  | `true`    |
| `--keep-tmp`                        | Keep temporary reimport directory for inspection           | `false`   |
| `--abap-language-version <version>` | ABAP language version for new objects (2=keyUser, 5=cloud) |           |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
